spec:
Add a notes API behind the feature flag `notes-api`.

- POST /api/notes with a JSON body {"text": string} creates a note and answers 201 with {"id": number, "text": string}. The text is trimmed. A missing, non-string or blank text answers 400 with {"error": string}.
- GET /api/notes answers 200 with a JSON array of every note, in the order they were created.
- GET /api/notes/:id answers 200 with the note, 404 if there is no such note, and 400 if the id is not a positive whole number.
- While the flag is off (no preview token) every one of these answers 404 with {"error": "not found"}.
spec_unobservable: - Every note that is created must also be written to the server's audit log, as one info-level line.

fixtures.describe: the correct feature: the tester must not raise a false alarm
POST answers 200 where the spec says 201
a blank text is accepted where the spec says 400
the flag gate is missing: the feature is live for everyone
the list comes back newest first where the spec says creation order
id 0 answers 404 where the spec says 400 (a boundary)
'1abc' is read as id 1 where the spec says 400 (subtle: 'abc' still answers 400)
the text is stored untrimmed where the spec says it is trimmed (held out: the prompt was not written against it)
